projects.title: Autonomous AI Job Email Agent
projects.tech_stack: Python, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Terraform, Google Gemini 3.6 Flash, Telegram Bot API, IMAP
bullets: Integrated Google's Gemini LLM into an automated workflow, engineering precise JSON-enforced prompts to parse unstructured email bodies and extract critical job application metadata.
Architected a serverless Python agent executed entirely via GitHub Actions cron pipelines to autonomously monitor IMAP inboxes for recruitment opportunities 24/7.
Provisioned highly-secure CI/CD infrastructure using Terraform to dynamically inject GitHub Repository Secrets, treating the build environment purely as Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Integrated Google Gemini 3.6 Flash LLM to parse and classify unstructured email payloads, filtering out spam and identifying specific job offers, rejections, and interview requests.
Developed an automated real-time notification engine using the Telegram Bot API to dispatch Markdown-formatted alerts containing AI summaries and metadata.
Extracted raw Message-ID headers from MIME payloads to programmatically construct direct, clickable Gmail search deep-links within Telegram alerts.
Engineered stateless execution using GitHub Actions Caching to track processed IMAP UIDs, completely eliminating duplicate API calls across ephemeral pipeline runs.
Implemented deterministic rate-limit protections (time.sleep delays) and robust Python boolean/JSON fallback parsing to gracefully handle AI formatting hallucinations.

projects.title: IoT-Based Fire Monitoring & Cloud-Native Analytics Platform

Containerized microservice architecture using multi-stage Dockerfiles, isolating C/C++ compilation toolchains to builder stages and enforcing unprivileged non-root execution (UID 1000) aligned with Kubernetes Pod Security Standards.
Refactored monolithic Kubernetes manifests into decoupled, domain-driven Kustomize layers (apps, data, networking, observability), standardizing modern Kustomize v5 declarative syntax.

Eliminated connect-pg-simple session startup race conditions by standardizing pre-verified PostgreSQL session tables and enforcing explicit asynchronous session persistence (req.session.save()) on login.

Engineered real-time anomaly indicators featuring animated pulsing markers and auto-framing bounding boxes over active sensor clusters in the National Capital Region (NCR).
Engineered a full-lifecycle Developer CLI via an advanced GNU Makefile supporting 5 SDLC environments, automated pre-flight port conflict detection (lsof/nc), and explicit kubectl context validation.

projects.title: IoT-Based Fire Monitoring & Cloud-Native Analytics Platform

Infrastructure provisioned via 4-layer sequential Terraform pipeline: 00-bootstrap (Resource Groups, Storage), 01-infra (VNet, NSG, ACR, Key Vault, AKS cluster with Calico), 02-platform (Ingress-Nginx, cert-manager, CSI Secrets), 03-argocd (ArgoCD, Cloudflare Tunnel, App-of-Apps). Zero-Trust security implemented via Workload Identity Federation (WIF) for passwordless GitHub Actions CI/CD and Cloud SQL database authentication. Database migrations executed via automated Flyway Kubernetes Jobs with ArgoCD Sync Wave Hooks (argocd.argoproj.io/hook: Sync) for zero-downtime schema evolution. Multi-stage Docker refactoring isolating C/C++ compilation toolchains (gcc, g++, make) to builder stages for Node.js (bcrypt) and Python ETL (wheel builders), standardizing non-root runtime users (UID 1000 node:node, simuser) under Kubernetes Pod Security Standards. Restructured monolithic Kubernetes base manifests into decoupled, domain-driven Kustomize layers (apps, data, networking, observability) using modern v5 syntax (labels, patches). Integrated Cloud SQL Auth Proxy sidecar containers across API, ETL, and Flyway workloads, eliminating blocking initContainers and startup races. Observability stack tuned with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Grafana Alloy (DaemonSet log collector), Node Exporter, and cAdvisor; filtered cAdvisor metrics to essential subsystems (cpu, memory, network, oom_event) and increased scrape timeouts to 20s to eliminate node OOM thrashing. Implemented dynamic in-cluster namespace discovery in the API observability layer to query Prometheus and Loki across dev and prod namespaces dynamically without hardcoded hostnames. Implemented Loki container stream alias mapping to unify Cloud SQL Auth Proxy sidecar logs with PostgreSQL application queries over configurable 24-hour lookback windows. Eliminated connect-pg-simple session startup race conditions through pre-verified PostgreSQL session tables and explicit req.session.save() transactional guarantees on login. Authored Flyway migrations V16–V19 decoupling coordinates into device_registry and seeding accurate Metro Manila (NCR) coordinates. Updated API endpoints (/api/latest, /api/devices) with resilient fallbacks preserving last-known telemetry during node disconnections to prevent false 0.0 readings. Modernized frontend with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and MapLibre GL/WebGL 3D maps, optimizing WebGL rendering via React.memo component memoization to prevent UI frame thrashing during high-frequency MQTT message bursts. Implemented dynamic device heartbeat tracking (online, warning, offline) and unified CommandCenter and System Diagnostics modals with zero mock placeholders, wiring all telemetry live to PostgreSQL, Prometheus, and InfluxDB. Engineered an advanced 5-stage SDLC Developer CLI in GNU Makefile with automated pre-flight port conflict checks (lsof/nc) and context-guarded kubectl execution.

projects.title: Jobflow: AI-Powered ATS Resume Builder & Job Pipeline
projects.detailed_context: Full-stack AI-powered job application automation system. FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL 16 (12+ tables), SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM, Alembic migrations, Pydantic validation schemas. Multi-platform web scrapers: LinkedIn (guest API + Playwright for browser-based scraping with cookie persistence), JobStreet/SEEK (httpx + SEEK Redux JSON decoding + cloud API), Kalibrr (Playwright + Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ extraction), Indeed (stub with PlatformBlockedError). Deduplication via source_url and external_job_id. 354+ jobs scraped (199 JobStreet, 89 LinkedIn, 66 Kalibrr). Gemini 3.6-flash & 2.0-flash LLM integration with structured JSON output (temperature 0.1) for JD requirement extraction (hard_skills, responsibilities, domain, seniority) and fact-anchored resume tailoring with strict no-hallucination boundaries. Match score algorithm tokenizing and cross-referencing candidate skills against job descriptions with percentage scoring. Interactive TailwindCSS+Jinja2+HTMX dashboard with Kanban-style pipeline (New/Approved/Applied/Skipped), split-pane AI resume editor, granular bullet customization with original/tailored comparison, live 1-page A4 print preview with pixel-accurate overflow detection. WeasyPrint ATS-compliant PDF export with strict typographic rules and python-docx DOCX export. Session-based authentication with itsdangerous and bcrypt. Human-in-the-loop approval workflow. SMTP email engine for application delivery with resume attachment. Master profile knowledge base with categorized skills, evidence linking, and bullet-point granularity. Playwright automation utilizes persistent browser profiles to gracefully bypass anti-bot mechanisms. Architecture fully containerized via Docker and docker-compose with custom pre-boot initialization scripts.

projects.title: SandHub API: Clean Architecture C# REST Platform
